steps.title: Disconnect power and gas
steps.body: Turn off gas supply and disconnect electrical power before servicing. Use appropriate PPE for live voltage checks.
steps.sourceExcerpt: Turn off the gas supply before working on/servicing the appliance. Disconnect power before working on electrical parts.

steps.title: Power and gas supply
steps.body: Verify 120 VAC to range and gas supply valve open.
steps.sourceExcerpt: Verify 120 VAC to range and gas supply valve open.

steps.title: Spark module voltage
steps.body: Check each surface burner terminal on spark module for voltage when knob turned.
steps.sourceExcerpt: Check each surface burner terminal on spark module for voltage when knob turned.

steps.title: Replace spark module
steps.oemOutcome: Replace spark module when no voltage to burner terminals.
